title: v5.2.9 — Account Panel Rework
message: Account panel is now full-screen for easier use. Profile badge shows your username instead of Gmail. New Display Name section lets you edit your name right in the Account panel with a Save button. Friend code and copy button are combined in one compact row. Referral link fixed — no longer shows localhost on APK or local testing. Cloud save timestamp cleaned up (just hours and minutes, no seconds). Sync Now has a brief delay so it feels deliberate. All login text updated from 'Sign in' to 'Log in'.
